name: console-kit-core
title: Constructive Console Kit Core
description: The leaf-independent Console Kit shell, runtime, discovery, and single modular Zustand store.
docs:
`console-kit-core` installed the shell, runtime, semantic routing, callback boundary, and one per-instance modular Zustand store. Core intentionally includes no feature view, so add selected `console-module-*` items.

Degraded states: explicit endpoint, current `_meta`, introspection, capability, and adapter evidence fail closed independently; installation never grants authority.

Guide: https://constructive-io.github.io/blocks/blocks/console-kit/
